title: Application SNMP Entity
description: Common properties shared by all SNMP applications (Net-SNMP).

listen_address.description: Address the SNMP agent listens on.

listen_port.description: Port the SNMP agent listens on.

system_location.description: Physical location of the system (sysLocation OID).

system_contact.description: Contact information for the system administrator (sysContact OID).
